prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing as soon as possible.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
